newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Benefit Bright signs HK$8.0 billion loan.
newsitem.headline: HK's Benefit Bright signs HK$8.0 billion loan.

text.p: Hong Kong's Benefit Bright has signed a pact with 30 banks for a HK$8.0 billion term loan to finance a property development project in the territory, the lead arrangers said on Wednesday.
Benefit Bright Ltd is a vehicle for a consortium comprising Sino Land Co Ltd, Kerry Properties, China Overseas Land and Investment and the Bank of China Group.
Proceeds are to be used to finance the Tai Kok Tsui Mass Transit Railway Package Two, which is one of many projects associated with Hong Kong's new airport and railway.
The four-year bullet loan pays a margin of 140 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate. Fees range between 40 and 57.5 basis points, depending on commitment.
China Development Finance Co, HSBC Investment Bank, Hang Seng Finance, Societe Generale Asia, BA Asia, Deutsche Bank Hong Kong branch and Westdeutsche Landesbank are lead arrangers.
